author: A.human.entity
text: I’ve dealt with a lot of home maintenance services, but these folks are top-tier. They arrived right on schedule, which is rare these days, and took the time to explain the condition of my system rather than just pumping and leaving. It’s clear they know their stuff and aren't looking to upsell you on unnecessary repairs. If you want a company that is honest, thorough, and respects your property, look no further.

author: Amanda Reynolds
text: Top notch service! We called everyone in Rutherford county and no one could get to us for a day or two even though we were backing up into the house but Blue Ridge worked us in and came all the way from Burke county just a couple hours later. They were quick and efficient, found our problem and fixed it quickly! Prices were still cheaper than some quoted by phone. Super nice and friendly! Definitely recommend and will use again in the future!

author: Trent Devinney
text: I called on Monday afternoon and they were there on Tuesday morning to clean my septic tank. Quick, efficient, and well priced! Would definitely use again when needed!

author: Kevin Haggerty
text: Wayne (the owner) is a man of integrity and character. He did a great job of communicating, showed him when he said he would, and his team did a great job. I would recommend Blue Ridge Septic to anyone!

author: Michael Isaacs
text: Basement was flooded because the City of Morganton sewer system backed up into my house.  Called BRS. Call was immediately answered.  Wayne was very courteous.  He arrived about an hour later with the truck, and promptly pumped over 2000 gallons of raw sewage out of my basement.  Professional, prompt, courteous and had the proper equipment.  Can't say enough good things about the service I received! Highly recommended. Would call again, but I hope I don't have to for this same problem. Thanks, Wayne!
